verdict.rationale: Adyen publishes an official GitHub repository, Adyen/adyen-openapi, with API definitions that users are told to import into Postman, so a machine-readable spec is downloadable. The probe 404s only show the spec is not served at guessed docs.adyen.com paths; that does not contradict the GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the risk-specific APIs (Referrals, Disputes) are covered in the spec, a spec link from the risk docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the download.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: we recommend you use Postman to import the API definition and create your personal collection of requests.
